method.rankResidual: leave-pair-out residual correlation of percentile ranks (scripts/audit/lineage_integrity_sweep.py::leave_pair_out_residuals), offense universe, picks excluded, >= 3 consensus observations per player, >= 30 players
method.valueResidualRaw: same construction on ln(value / board max) over boards publishing positive native values; includes shared curve shape
method.valueResidualDetrended: valueResidualRaw after removing each residual's least-squares cubic in the consensus ln-value (curve shape removed)
method.lpo: consensus = voting pool minus both members (the sweep's rule)
method.lfo: consensus additionally excludes every pool source in either member's B10 correlation group or from either member's provider
method.partial: r(A,B | Z) on residuals against a consensus excluding A, B and Z
method.cp: common population: every member and every consensus board covering >= 60% of the members' shared players re-ranked inside the players they ALL rank (removes the per-board-percentile depth artifact)
method.cpx: cp with TE rows removed (value bases differ: KTC TE++ vs base boards)
method.baseline: leave-pair-out residuals share the consensus error: expect about +1/(k+1) for k equally noisy consensus boards even with no dependence
method.snapshots: every 7 days 2026-05-16..2026-10-01 at 23:59:59Z; each board = last committed CSV version at or before the instant
